title: org-rally-playbook-and-decision-reservoir-v0-1
content:
Purpose and framing:
- Quick playbook for a 90-minute ‘Org Rally’ to align execs, leads, and ICs on the upcoming quarter and lock micro-commitments. Not a full all-hands — this is goal-focused, decision-forward, and intentionally tactical.

Top-level objectives for the rally:
1) Recalibrate: surface top 3 cross-org risks and mitigation owners.
2) Commit: capture micro-commitments (week-by-week owners and acceptance criteria) for the next 6 weeks.
3) Decide: use the Decision Reservoir (see section) to resolve 2 prioritized tradeoffs that block launches.
4) Communicate: produce a 1-page exec update and a 6-slide summary for the all-hands.

Audience and invite list (core):
- Founders & Execs (CEO, CTO, VP Product)
- Leads: eng-serving-runtime, product-hosted-api, eng-platform-engineering, go-to-market, customer-success
- 6 rotating ICs (one per major OKR lane)

Run of show (90 min):
- 00:00–00:05 — Welcome, framing, "what success looks like" (Host: Maya Chen)
- 00:05–00:20 — Signals: 2-min rapid updates from 4 lanes (latency/cost/quality/ops) — one slide each; no longer than 4 minutes per lane lead
- 00:20–00:40 — Risk surface: top 6 cross-org risks (owner + mitigation table) — live read and quick clarifying Qs
- 00:40–01:05 — Decision session A: prioritize and resolve the top blockers (use the Decision Reservoir voting) — facilitator: Jordan Miles
- 01:05–01:25 — Commitment workshop: draft micro-commitments by lane (3 bullets each: owner, due, acceptance criteria) — breakout by lane, 10 min; reconvene 10 min
- 01:25–01:30 — Wrap: confirm next steps, communications, and who updates the one-pager

Pre-read and artifacts to circulate 48 hours prior:
- 1-page status snapshot (metrics: latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, infra utilization, tickets >P2 by lane)
- current OKR draft (headlines + why we care)
- Decision Reservoir shortlist (5 items)
- Proposed micro-commitment template (owner; what done looks like; blockers)

Decision Reservoir (intent: capture and triage decisions ahead of the rally) — short process:
- Each lane owner drops 1–2 candidate decisions in this list (deadline: 72 hrs pre-rally).
- Steering committee upvotes top 2 per lane.
- Rally decides top 2 global decisions for a live-resolution slot.

Sample Decision Reservoir entries (examples):
- Should we prioritize Redwood Dedicated autoscaling polish before Q3 GA or ship GA with documented limitations? (owner: eng-platform-engineering) — blocker: internal infra fragility under mixed workload
- Accept 12h mitigation window for on-prem private deploys for initial customers vs. require 99% SLA out of the gate? (owner: product-private-deployments)

OKR draft (top-level lanes — very concise):
- Objective A: Make inference predictable and cheaper for PLG customers
  - KR1: Reduce average cost/token by 18% on common prompt tranche (owner: Optimize)
  - KR2: Increase 99th percentile latency SLA compliance to 98% on hosted-api routes (owner: hosted-api)
- Objective B: Harden Dedicated and Private for enterprise adoption
  - KR1: Complete VPC onboarding UX and KMS integration for 3 pilot customers (owner: private-deployments)
  - KR2: Release autoscaling policy templates and validate at 2x baseline load (owner: dedicated)
- Objective C: Developer experience and trust
  - KR1: Ship console tracing hooks + token-cost breakdown per route (owner: console-and-rollouts)
  - KR2: Reduce mean time to detection for regressions to <24h using eval hooks (owner: applied-ml)

Micro-commitment template (what to collect in the workshop):
- Lane: eng-serving-runtime
- Commitment: Finish KV cache cold-start optimization on staging and run perf sweep on 3 canonical models
- Owner: Priya S.
- Due: 2026-03-20
- Acceptance criteria: <5% tail latency regression vs baseline + automated smoke tests in CI

Risks and mitigations (short table text):
- Risk: Burst capacity exhaustion during enterprise pilots — Mitigation: Enable burst queue + fallback to smaller model variants; owner: dedicated
- Risk: Eval regressions slip into production after quantization experiments — Mitigation: Locked eval set + gated deployment + rollback runbook; owner: applied-ml
- Risk: Customer onboarding friction for private (network + KMS) — Mitigation: Pre-approved network templates, playbook + SRE onsite window; owner: private-deployments

Communications: deliverables after the rally
- 1-page Exec Update (author: Maya Chen) — publish to /company channel and attach to the all-hands pre-read
- 6-slide Rally Summary (author: product-hosted-api) — to be used as the first slides of the next all-hands
- Micro-commitment tracker (sheet) — owner: operations (link to sheet in linked artifacts)

Logistics checklist (owner: Maya Chen unless noted):
- Book 90-min room + virtual dial-in (done)
- Collect 1-page snapshots from each lane (deadline: 48h prior) — follow up owners: lane leads
- Prepare voting mechanism (Google Form + Miro board) — owner: Jordan Miles
- Pre-commit Decision Reservoir shortlist — owner: Sofia Alvarez
- Draft 1-pager + slide skeleton — owner: product-hosted-api

Execution notes / rehearsal guidance:
- Keep signals strictly to slide + 2 minutes each; enforce timebox with a visual timer.
- Use the Decision Reservoir to move low-value debates offline: if a decision cannot be resolved in 10 minutes, escalate to a small working group and capture required inputs.
- For each micro-commitment, require a testable acceptance criteria (no vague promises).

Post-rally cadence (who updates what):
- Week 0 (within 48h): Publish 1-page update and slide summary to company drive (owner: Maya Chen)
- Week 1: PM + Eng leads publish sprint plan mapping to micro-commitments (owner: lane leads)
- Week 3: Midpoint check-in: 15-min async update in #company-rally — tag owners and blockers
- Week 6: Retro + decision log update; escalate unresolved items to exec working group

Decision log (live during rally — capture as quick bullets):
- Decision 1: Ship Dedicated GA with documented autoscaling caveats; commit to post-GA autoscale polish. Owner: eng-platform-engineering. Rationale: unblock sales pilots.
- Decision 2: For first 3 private pilots, accept 12h mitigation window; aim for SLA ramp by pilot #4. Owner: product-private-deployments.

Open questions for exec attention (prep list):
- Are we comfortable with temporarily exposing a reduced-availability tier to early enterprise customers to accelerate product-market fit?
- Do we prioritize cost optimization (Optimize) across all traffic or focus on high-volume PLG routes first?

Appendix: Quick links and references (pre-read sources):
- Latency & cost dashboard: (internal) link — include top 5 alerting charts
- Recent postmortem: incident-DEG-2026-01-19 — summary highlights
- Autoscale design doc: /docs/autoscale-design-v1

Notes to self / informal prep list (scratch):
- Bring 3 tangible asks for execs (funding runway, headcount reallocation, one cross-org contractor)
- Confirm SRE takes the on-call window for the 72h post-release ramp
- Make a clear CTA at the end: who owns the one-pager + 72h followups

End of playbook.

(Working doc — rough bullets, happy to iterate. If anything in the Decision Reservoir is sensitive, flag it and we can move to private notes.)
